text:
maya: quick follow-up from today's congestion sync: we still lack a crisp ingress -> admission handoff. do we push aggregated signals or keep admission pulling metrics?

sam: push seems better for decision latency. ingress already aggregates p95 and queue depth. send a compact envelope once per second. :+1:

jordan: push OK but avoid signal storms. aggregate at 1s and add jitter. also include a schema version so we can roll policies.

li: important: ingress only sends telemetry/signals. admission must be the authoritative actor for penalties and quota changes. no ingress-side mutations.

sam: rough proto idea: Envelope { tenant, tokens_in_flight, p95_ms, pending, abuse_score, trace_id, version } -> Decision { allowed_tokens | credit_delta, mode, ttl, fairness_weight }. keep responses tiny.

maya: ops note: decisions need TTL and ingress fallbacks when stale. also standardize client-facing responses: 429 for client limit, 503 for overloaded. add headers X-Redwood-Decision, X-Redwood-Estimate-ms.

jordan: add audit event on any eviction/penalty and include trace_id for replay. observability is critical.

li: abuse policy: if abuse_score > 0.9 route to probation via admission with probation_ttl and reduced weight. ingress cannot bypass.

sam: phased rollout plan: phase1 push-only envelopes + read-only admission decisions; phase2 lease API + probation enforcement; phase3 full abuse-detector integration and console controls.

maya: action items: @sam proto + server stub (wed), @jordan aggregation/jitter helpers (thu), @li abuse contract (thu), I'll draft rollout playbook (fri). ops-bot: will wire canary alerts.

ops-bot: noted: canary start tomorrow 08:00 UTC. watch slo channels. :eyes:

maya: thanks all, logging this into RFC follow-ups. :thumbsup:
